requirements.text: CIK de 10 dígitos es la identidad primaria; ticker es alias no autoritativo.
una coincidencia ambigua produce `identity_ambiguous` local; nunca selección automática.
una operación SEC tiene presupuesto fijo de 14 llamadas externas.
Submissions y Company Facts se solicitan antes de cualquier Company Concept.
Company Concept se solicita solo para conceptos no resueltos, allowlisted y con mapping exacto `ACTIVE`.
el orden de fallback es estable: allowlist del perfil → prioridad de métrica → precedencia de mapping → conceptId.
agotado el presupuesto, se publica resultado `partial` si hay payload utilizable; no se ejecuta una llamada 15.
cada fact mantiene `factId`, concepto canónico, período, scope, decimal canónico, mapping/version y sourceRef.
los estados de fact resolution son `resolved|absent|ambiguous|incompatible`.
la cobertura agregada usa `complete|partial|missing|not_applicable`; no sustituye al estado del fact.
perfiles aplican allowlists de conceptos y métricas; elementos fuera de allowlist son `not_applicable` o `absent`, nunca inferidos.
`unsupported_profile` es un resultado local normal que conserva identidad, filings y evidencia; no es HTTP 422.
el catálogo ejecutable contiene exactamente 24 métricas fundamentales activas y 8 de precio activas.
cada métrica declara fórmula, inputs, prioridad, perfiles, calidad mínima, rounding, consumidores y dominio de fingerprint.
deuda usa buckets exactos no solapados; un total genérico o lease-inclusive no se usa sin mapping exacto explícito.
calidad fundamental y calidad de precio son modelos distintos y no comparten ejes implícitos.
cada una de las 9 reglas activas usa AST validado por `rule-node.schema.json`, perfiles, calidad mínima y consumidores.
cada regla tiene tres fixtures: triggered, not_triggered y not_evaluable.
una regla nunca se evalúa si un input requerido está indisponible o por debajo de la calidad mínima.
un bundle/snapshot fundamental no contiene overlay, métricas ni fingerprints de precio.
un overlay es inmutable por versión; reemplazarlo crea nueva versión y actualiza solo el pointer de precio.
importar o borrar precio no modifica bundle, análisis, snapshot ni pointer fundamental.
precio se usa únicamente para métricas históricas descriptivas; no interviene en reglas fundamentales.
`displayAgeDays`, `evaluationDate` y cualquier dato derivado del reloj son solo de presentación.
serialización canónica RFC 8785 JCS y SHA-256 con prefijo `sha256:`.
`fundamentalInputFingerprint`, `fundamentalAnalysisFingerprint`, `historicalPriceOverlayFingerprint`, `priceAnalysisFingerprint` y `sourceEvidenceFingerprint` tienen proyecciones distintas.
fingerprints, timestamps de visualización y campos de reloj quedan excluidos de su propia proyección.
cambiar evidencia opcional o precio no cambia fingerprints fundamentales.
toda publicación valida fingerprints contra test vectors.
apertura/reanudación usa snapshot local sin red cuando `refreshConsent=false`.

con `refreshConsent=true`, apertura/reanudación aplica cache determinística: `fresh <6h` sin red, `stale_revalidatable 6h–<7d` consulta Submissions primero, y `expired ≥7d` intenta actualizar preservando el último snapshot válido; Company Facts solo se solicita ante novedad, cache miss, cambio de autoridad dependiente o refresh manual.
el usuario siempre dispone de **Actualizar fundamentales**, que fuerza una comprobación puntual; no existe scheduler ni actualización mientras la aplicación está cerrada.
cambios de mappings/métricas/reglas invalidan solo dependencias afectadas.
IndexedDB publica candidatos mediante una única transacción atómica y compare-and-swap de pointer.
fallo/cancelación deja los pointers previos intactos y no crea huérfanos.

antes del borrado total existe exportación/restauración local versionada con preview; borrar precio preserva fundamentales y borrar todos los datos es atómico, confirmado y reversible mediante un backup válido.
pipeline usa una única matriz de transiciones; toda transición no listada está prohibida.
states de facts, cobertura, métricas y pipeline son enums separados.
solo el gateway emite Problem Details; identidad ambigua, cancelación, quality gate y consentimiento son issues locales.
OpenAPI expone exactamente la matriz operación×status×variant; 409 y 422 no forman parte de la superficie activa.
cada estado/error preserva y bloquea capabilities explícitas y ofrece recuperación UI alcanzable.

cambios de estado, errores, limitaciones y confirmaciones destructivas cumplen los oráculos aplicables de `wcag-2.2-aa-matrix.json`, son anunciables, operables por teclado, con foco no obstruido y reduced motion.
mismos inputs/versiones producen mismos outputs/fingerprints.
datos personales permanecen locales salvo requests SEC explícitos.
User-Agent/contacto obligatorios, concurrencia 1, máximo 14 llamadas por operación, 3 intentos lógicos, backoff 1/2/4 s, request timeout 20 s, operación 120 s y respuesta máxima 64 MiB.
el último snapshot válido permanece utilizable ante fallos.
JSON, schemas, OpenAPI, referencias, fixtures y crosswalk son validables sin código de producto.
cada dominio tiene autoridad primaria y consumidores bidireccionales.
WCAG 2.2 AA es requisito verificable según 21 oráculos release-blocking; reduced motion se trata además como requisito de producto.

exactly 3 fixtures for each of 9 ACTIVE rules: triggered, not_triggered, not_evaluable
one of five exact synthesis enums
fundamentalAnalysisFingerprint is identical; evidence and all price artifacts are outside projection

status references only allowed code variants
operation-specific resource_not_found variant with const resourceType and nonempty resourceId
fundamentals reach ready without price; any overlay is a separate immutable version and never enters the fundamental bundle
storage_consent_required; analysis remains usable in memory

issuer CIK,period,profile and snapshot context remain visible
every listed recovery action maps to one active UI operation and preserves exactly the catalog capabilities
export/import is available before deletion; delete_all_personal_data atomically removes all personal records and pointers or rolls back completely

fundamentalInputFingerprint and fundamentalAnalysisFingerprint remain identical; price fingerprints differ
persisted overlay rejects displayAgeDays/evaluationDate; fingerprint is independent of UI evaluation date
only explicit allowlisted concepts/mappings/metrics are attempted; no inferred concept is used
submissions once, Company Facts once, then at most 12 ordered Company Concept fallbacks; total external calls=14
OpenAPI exposes exactly matrix-listed HTTP variants; 409 and 422 are absent; local issues are absent
each domain has one primary authority, at least one consumer, exact anchor, and every consumer reverse-links to every declared domain

findings.title: The task plan inserts a second “analysis” after implementation instead of convergence
findings.summary: Phase 10, the dependency graph and T109 state that final validation leads to a separate analysis and that the gate remains closed pending that analysis. Constitution 3.1.0 XII.1 requires analysis → implementation → convergence, with no second analysis phase.
evidence: Constitution XII.1: mandatory order ends analysis → implementation → convergence.
tasks.md Phase 10: “prepare evidence for the separate analysis phase”.
tasks.md dependency graph: “final validation → separate analysis”.
T109 Done when: gate remains closed pending separate analysis.
findings.impact: A subordinate task artifact changes the constitutional lifecycle and leaves the post-implementation gate transition undefined. This is a direct phase-order conflict.
findings.remediation: Reframe T109 and the dependency graph as convergence-input / post-implementation convergence evidence. Do not add or reopen an analysis phase after implementation. Preserve implementationAuthorized=false until the current analysis passes.

findings.title: Metric tasks do not depend on the formula and quality implementations they normatively consume
findings.summary: T042 implements 24 fundamental metrics but omits T041 even though every active metric resolves to a closed formula definition, and omits T043 despite claiming quality gates. T067 has the same defect for eight price metrics and instead depends on unrelated fundamental metric/debt tasks.
evidence: metric-catalog.json assigns formulaId to all 32 active metrics.
AC-028 requires every active metric to resolve to exactly one closed FormulaDefinition.
T041 implements the 15 formula definitions; T043 implements the quality classifiers.
T042 dependencies: T039,T040. T067 dependencies: T040,T042,T063.
findings.impact: Implementers can duplicate arithmetic or invent interfaces, defeating ROUND_HALF_EVEN, DecimalString, reason precedence and deterministic quality classification.
findings.remediation: Declare the actual producer-consumer dependencies and remove unrelated cross-domain prerequisites. Ensure fundamental and price metric tasks consume the single formula engine and the authorized quality classifier.

findings.title: Synthesis, Web Worker publication and first-analysis E2E can execute before their required producers
findings.summary: T045 synthesizes rule outcomes without depending on T044; T048 publishes a normalization/analysis candidate without depending on T047 candidate builders; T053 claims metric and insight acceptance without waiting for T051/T052.
evidence: AC-036 precondition is “rule outcomes set”; T044 is the rule evaluator, but T045 depends only on T043.
T047 builds FundamentalBundle/FundamentalAnalysis candidates; T048 depends only on T023,T046.
T053 cites FR-013, FR-017, AC-028 and AC-035 but omits metric and insight UI tasks T051,T052.
findings.impact: The first vertical slice may be declared complete while metrics, rules, synthesis or immutable candidates are absent or only stubbed.
findings.remediation: Add the missing producer dependencies and make the first-analysis E2E close the entire cited behavior from CIK through metrics, rules, synthesis and fingerprints.

findings.title: Refresh orchestration is sequenced before its consent repository and its E2E omits required flows
findings.summary: T060 implements consent-aware open/resume before T072 creates separate refresh/storage consent records. T061 promises quota/fair-access enforcement without depending on the quota guard. T062 claims stale, cancellation and refresh coverage while omitting T059, T060 and T061.
evidence: CLR-023 and update-orchestration require distinct refreshConsent and storageConsent.
T072 is the only task that implements consent records/revocation, but it occurs two phases after T060.
T061 Done when says manual refresh never bypasses quota guards; T090 implements those guards later.
T062 dependencies exclude stale degradation T059, open/resume T060 and manual refresh T061.
findings.impact: Network can be triggered with ambiguous consent state, and the story-level E2E can pass without testing the user-visible refresh paths it claims to close.
findings.remediation: Move or split the consent foundation before lifecycle orchestration, connect manual/open-resume flows to idempotency, retry, degradation and quota guards, and make T062 depend on every exercised implementation.

findings.title: The price story dependency graph is cross-wired and does not close parser → preview → overlay → metrics → events → UI → E2E
findings.summary: T065 depends on refresh UI rather than CSV/manual parsers; T066 depends on fundamental synthesis/refresh and omits price inputs and fingerprint service; T068 omits overlay/metric producers; T069/T070/T071 omit the services and UIs they exercise.
evidence: T065 dependencies are T060,T061 instead of T063,T064.
T066 dependencies are T014,T045,T062 and omit T046,T063,T064,T065.
T068 omits T066,T067; T070 omits T067; T071 omits T068,T069,T070.
The story requires import/replace/delete isolation and all eight metrics.
findings.impact: Price processing can be built against undefined inputs, E2E can run without event/UI integration, and the fundamental/price isolation invariant may remain unproven.
findings.remediation: Rebuild the story DAG around the normative data flow and keep all fundamental dependencies limited to shared types/fingerprint primitives, not fundamental synthesis or refresh UI.

findings.title: Persistence lifecycle consumers are not connected to repositories and restore/delete services
findings.summary: Export depends on price UIs instead of record repositories; restore and delete omit preview/repository prerequisites; the data-management UI omits the services it exposes; persistence E2E omits restore/delete/UI tasks. T077 is a terminal leaf.
evidence: T075 dependencies omit T073,T074.
T079 omits T075–T078; T080 omits T076–T079.
Graph leaf T077 is never consumed by UI, E2E or final validation.
findings.impact: Atomic restore, rollback, pre-export and delete semantics can remain unintegrated while the user story and final lifecycle are marked complete.
findings.remediation: Connect repositories to export/restore/delete services, connect services to UI, and require the full service/UI chain before persistence E2E and final integration validation.

findings.title: The accessibility remediation task has no product source paths and final WCAG closure omits required work
findings.summary: T086 says it adds names/instructions/errors to all forms/actions but lists only a test file. T087/T088/T104 do not wait for the complete accessibility implementation and user flows; T085 is a leaf and T088 is outside T109 closure.
evidence: T086 files: tests/e2e/accessibility/names-errors.spec.ts only.
T087 omits T083–T086; T088 depends only on T083; T104 depends only on T083,T084.
The active matrix contains 55 A/AA criteria, 43 applicable and 12 justified N/A.
Axe is explicitly supplemental, not a substitute for manual verification.
findings.impact: Mandatory labels, error associations, reflow, contrast, target size and manual criteria can be absent while the conformance report claims 55/55 closure.
findings.remediation: Give T086 exact product files or split it by feature UI; make automated/manual/final reviews depend on all applicable UI and accessibility tasks; preserve explicit manual oracles and N/A reopen triggers.

findings.title: Cloudflare validation does not depend on the D1, build and performance evidence it claims to validate
findings.summary: T105 claims quota/build/CPU/memory/subrequest/D1/degradation validation but omits T093–T096. T093 is a graph leaf. T095 does not depend on streaming implementation T028, and T096 omits the persistence implementations whose budgets it measures.
evidence: T105 dependencies stop at T092 and exclude T093,T094,T095,T096.
T095 dependencies: T027,T088; streaming implementation is T028.
T096 dependencies omit T073–T080 despite measuring IndexedDB.
T099 runbook can complete before degradation/observability/performance/security tasks T091–T098.
findings.impact: The documented zero-cost and runtime-safety gate may be issued without the measurements named in its own Done-when criterion.
findings.remediation: Make validation depend on every budget producer, make performance tests depend on measured implementations, and finalize deployment/rollback documentation after the evidence and degradation controls exist.

findings.title: Final validation and T109 do not transitively cover the implementation tree
findings.summary: The aggregate unit/integration/E2E tasks omit suites and implementations named in their descriptions. T109 reaches only 94 of 109 tasks and excludes 15 tasks, including restore, accessibility, Cloudflare, documentation and architecture invariants.
evidence: T100 omits T011,T017,T044,T046,T054 despite naming decimal/state/rules/fingerprints/cache.
T102 omits acquisition runner, Web Worker pipeline, idempotency and restore service.
T103 omits story-level E2Es T053,T062,T071,T080 and full accessibility closure.
T109 transitive closure excludes T010,T019,T077,T085,T088,T091–T096,T105–T108.
findings.impact: A final evidence report can be generated without all release gates, invalidating the claimed implementation readiness and preventing reversible traceability from final proof back to each task.
findings.remediation: Define explicit aggregate suite membership or commands, make each aggregate task depend on all relevant producers, and make the final convergence-input report transitively include every required implementation, validation and documentation task.

findings.title: Mandatory SEC User-Agent/contact and redirect handling lack an explicit implementation task and oracle
findings.summary: NFR-003 and the security contract require SEC_USER_AGENT and SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL deployment variables. No task names, validates or fails closed on those variables. A cross-host redirect negative fixture exists, but no task explicitly defines manual redirect handling and Location revalidation.
evidence: NFR-003: User-Agent/contact mandatory.
security-and-input-limits.json requiredDeploymentVariables: SEC_USER_AGENT, SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL.
No occurrence of those names or User-Agent exists in tasks.md.
Fixture sec-cross-host-redirect exists; T097 source paths do not include the gateway fetch/redirect path.
findings.impact: The implementation could violate SEC fair-access identification or follow an untrusted redirect while still satisfying the present task wording.
findings.remediation: Add exact Worker environment bindings, startup/request fail-closed behavior, outbound header construction, redirect=manual/allowlist revalidation, redaction tests and frozen positive/negative contract oracles.

findings.title: Runtime quarantine of corrupt local records is tested but has no implementation task
findings.summary: The security and browser-storage authorities require corrupt/hash-mismatched records to be quarantined and excluded from active pointers. T080 mentions corruption E2E, but no task implements read-path verification, quarantine storage/state or pointer recovery.
evidence: security-and-input-limits.json corruptionRecovery requires quarantine and active-pointer exclusion.
browser-storage.md repeats the same requirement.
T076 covers restore candidates; T073 covers writes; neither implements existing-record read-path quarantine.
T080 cannot test a missing corruption-recovery implementation.
findings.impact: A corrupt record may remain active, crash the application or be silently discarded, violating local-first integrity and recoverability.
findings.remediation: Add an explicit repository/read-path integrity and quarantine task with schema/hash validation, pointer exclusion/repair, visible recovery action and deterministic tests.

findings.title: The published parallel execution example violates declared dependencies
findings.summary: The example says to run T011–T015 in parallel after T010, but T015 depends on T012 and several tasks require T001/T002/T005 rather than T010 alone.
evidence: tasks.md parallel example: “After T010, run T011–T015 … in parallel”.
T015 Depends on T012; T011/T012/T014 have other setup prerequisites.
findings.impact: A manual implementer can start tasks in an invalid wave and create temporary incompatible interfaces or failed tests.
findings.remediation: Replace examples with explicit dependency-respecting waves and state that [P] means parallel only after every declared prerequisite is complete.

findings.title: Several dependencies serialize unrelated domains while omitting actual prerequisites
findings.summary: Examples include T057→T052, T065→T060/T061, T066→T045/T062, T091→T086, T094→T086 and T095→T088. These edges are not justified by files, contracts or data flow.
evidence: Idempotency depends on the insight UI.
Price preview/overlay depend on refresh UI/fundamental synthesis.
Quota/build/performance tasks depend on accessibility tasks rather than measured runtime producers.
findings.impact: The DAG over-serializes implementation, obscures true producer-consumer relationships and makes the stated parallelism misleading.
findings.remediation: Remove non-material edges, replace them with authority/interface prerequisites, and rerun cycle, reachability, file-collision and semantic dependency checks.

rootCauses.title: Dependency QA was syntactic, not semantic
rootCauses.description: The baseline correctly checks unique IDs, existing edges and cycles, but does not prove producer-consumer reachability, final-gate closure or data-flow prerequisites.

rootCauses.title: Coverage mappings were treated as implementation proof
rootCauses.description: A requirement/AC is mapped to a task with a test path, yet the task or aggregate validation can run before the behavior or remediation it claims to verify.

rootCauses.title: Cross-story sequencing mixes UI, domain and persistence readiness
rootCauses.description: UI tasks are used as prerequisites for domain services, while the true repositories, protocols or event producers are omitted or scheduled later.

rootCauses.title: Exact external-policy controls are not decomposed into executable tasks
rootCauses.description: WCAG remediation, SEC identification/redirect controls and IndexedDB quarantine are present in authorities or tests but lack exact product source paths and measurable implementation oracles.

rootCauses.title: Post-implementation governance terminology is inconsistent with the constitution
rootCauses.description: The task plan carries forward a “separate analysis” after implementation instead of producing evidence for the constitutionally next convergence phase.

normativeClauses.text: Los fundamentales son el núcleo obligatorio del producto.
SEC EDGAR/XBRL es la fuente estructurada principal del MVP.
El sistema DEBE conservar filing, período, moneda, unidad, scope, taxonomía, tag, accession number, fecha de presentación y lineage de revisión.
Una ausencia legítima NO DEBE convertirse en un error global: se representa como `insufficient` o `not_applicable` según corresponda.
El producto NO DEBE emitir recomendaciones de inversión, órdenes, objetivos de precio ni promesas de rentabilidad.
El CIK normalizado a diez dígitos es la identidad primaria del emisor SEC.
El ticker, nombre comercial, símbolo o MIC son aliases informativos y temporales.
Un alias nunca PUEDE sustituir al CIK como clave de adquisición o persistencia.
Una identidad ambigua DEBE detener el flujo con `identity_ambiguous`; nunca se adivina.
No se precarga el universo SEC.
La adquisición se inicia al seleccionar un emisor, mediante `manual_refresh` o con consentimiento previo de actualización al abrir o reanudar la aplicación.
Abrir o reanudar sin consentimiento NO DEBE generar solicitudes externas.
Company Facts es la fuente principal de hechos XBRL.
Company Concept solo puede utilizarse como fallback selectivo bajo condiciones normativas cerradas y presupuesto único.

El análisis DEBE adaptarse mediante perfiles versionados: `general_operating_us_gaap`, `general_operating_ifrs_limited`, `financial_institution_limited`, `insurance_limited`, `reit_limited` y `unsupported_profile`.
Solo `general_operating_us_gaap` aspira inicialmente al pack fundamental completo.
Los perfiles limitados publican únicamente métricas expresamente allowlisted.
Un mapping ambiguo nunca se adivina.
Una métrica incompatible se publica como `not_applicable`; una métrica compatible con inputs insuficientes se publica como `insufficient`.

normativeClauses.section: V. Arquitectura y separación de responsabilidades
normativeClauses.text: Cloudflare Pages sirve la interfaz estática.

normativeClauses.section: V. Arquitectura y separación de responsabilidades
normativeClauses.text: Cloudflare Worker funciona como gateway SEC liviano: valida, aplica límites, cachea y retransmite respuestas permitidas; no ejecuta normalización contable intensiva.

normativeClauses.section: V. Arquitectura y separación de responsabilidades
normativeClauses.text: La normalización, resolución de mappings, métricas e insights se ejecuta en Web Worker.

normativeClauses.section: V. Arquitectura y separación de responsabilidades
normativeClauses.text: D1 se limita a metadata, catálogos, versiones, mappings y políticas; no almacena histories masivos, raw SEC completos ni análisis personales.

normativeClauses.section: V. Arquitectura y separación de responsabilidades
normativeClauses.text: El análisis personal y los snapshots permanecen locales en IndexedDB con consentimiento.
Toda salida DEBE permitir recorrer fuente -> filing -> fact -> mapping -> métrica -> regla -> síntesis -> snapshot.
Valores financieros se normalizan como strings decimales antes de canonicalizar.
Los fingerprints usan JCS RFC 8785, SHA-256, allowlists únicas, arrays en orden normativo, ausencia distinta de `null`, rechazo de NaN/Infinity y normalización de `-0`.
La evidencia opcional no modifica resultados ni fingerprints de entrada o salida.
Mismas entradas allowlisted y mismas versiones DEBEN producir los mismos bytes y salida.
La calidad se expresa mediante `DataQualityProfile` categórico.
No existen `rawScore`, `score`, pesos, caps, gates o bandas numéricas de confianza.
La clasificación `verified|usable_with_caveats|insufficient` es una función total y sin solapamientos de mapping, completitud, comparabilidad y revisión.
Una combinación ambigua, missing, incompatible o conflicted siempre es `insufficient`.
Una métrica solo puede estar activa con inputs, períodos, scope, unidad, estados, calidad, fingerprint y consumidores cerrados.
Deuda y EBITDA siguen definiciones únicas; deuda parcial bloquea ratios dependientes.
Los insights usan exclusivamente un AST cerrado: `all`, `any`, `count_at_least`, `comparison`, `metric_state_is` y `quality_is_at_least`.
Cada regla produce `triggered|not_triggered|not_evaluable`.
La síntesis es total: `insufficient_information|neutral|favorable|unfavorable|mixed`.
El producto no inventa facts, mappings, métricas, reglas ni conclusiones.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: La capa de mercado es opcional y se modela como `HistoricalPriceOverlay`.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: Sus series pueden ser `single`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly` o `irregular`.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: No se requieren cotizaciones en tiempo real, diarias ni semanales.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: El mercado puede cargarse mediante CSV o entrada manual desde la UI.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: Proveedores automáticos, credenciales BYO-key, entitlement, cuotas, refresh automático, calendarios bursátiles y venue registry están fuera del MVP.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: No existe `valuation_eligible`; toda observación de mercado es descriptiva y nunca bloquea fundamentales.

normativeClauses.section: IX. Mercado opcional y no bloqueante
normativeClauses.text: Valuación dependiente del precio está fuera del MVP.

normativeClauses.section: X. Snapshots locales y operación desde UI
normativeClauses.text: `PersonalAnalysisSnapshot` es inmutable.

normativeClauses.section: X. Snapshots locales y operación desde UI
normativeClauses.text: La activación local se realiza atómicamente en una transacción IndexedDB que persiste candidato, índice de evidencia y `activeSnapshotId`; ante fallo conserva el pointer previo.

normativeClauses.section: X. Snapshots locales y operación desde UI
normativeClauses.text: Todos los flujos ordinarios operan desde la interfaz: descubrir emisor, actualizar, cancelar, importar precio, revisar preview, confirmar, borrar y gestionar consentimiento.

normativeClauses.section: X. Snapshots locales y operación desde UI
normativeClauses.text: La terminal no es requisito de usuario.

normativeClauses.section: X. Snapshots locales y operación desde UI
normativeClauses.text: Publicación central automática, scheduler público, active snapshot D1 público, invalidación ETag por publicación y GitHub Actions como runtime de ingestión están fuera del MVP.

normativeClauses.section: XI. Seguridad, privacidad, accesibilidad y sostenibilidad
normativeClauses.text: No se almacenan secretos, API keys, tokens, cookies ni credenciales de mercado.

normativeClauses.section: XI. Seguridad, privacidad, accesibilidad y sostenibilidad
normativeClauses.text: Los payloads y archivos se validan por tamaño, tipo, estructura y límites antes de uso.

normativeClauses.section: XI. Seguridad, privacidad, accesibilidad y sostenibilidad
normativeClauses.text: La interfaz DEBE cumplir WCAG 2.2 AA para teclado, foco, labels, estados busy, `aria-live`, cancelación, recuperación y confirmaciones destructivas.

normativeClauses.section: XI. Seguridad, privacidad, accesibilidad y sostenibilidad
normativeClauses.text: Se priorizan capacidades gratuitas permanentes; toda dependencia externa DEBE tener presupuesto, degradación y política documentada.

normativeClauses.section: XI. Seguridad, privacidad, accesibilidad y sostenibilidad
normativeClauses.text: Las extensiones futuras son no normativas hasta una enmienda constitucional y una fase Spec-Driven completa.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: El orden obligatorio es: constitución → especificación → aclaración → plan → checklist → tareas → análisis → implementación → convergencia.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: El archivo de estado de fase vigente identificado por `DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md` es la única autoridad del paquete para los flags de autorización.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: Ningún documento subordinado, reporte histórico, checklist anterior o metadata PUEDE ampliar un gate cerrado por la autoridad de fase vigente.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: `tasks.md` solo PUEDE existir como artefacto activo después de un checklist formal independiente con decisión `APPROVED_FOR_TASKS` y sin hallazgos bloqueantes o mayores.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: La implementación solo PUEDE abrirse después de que `spec.md`, `plan.md` y `tasks.md` sean consistentes y un análisis transversal post-tareas concluya sin bloqueantes.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: Convergencia y release solo PUEDE abrirse después de implementación incremental, validaciones contractuales, seguridad, accesibilidad y cierre de hallazgos residuales.

normativeClauses.section: XII. Spec-Driven phase gates and single gate authority
normativeClauses.text: Los artefactos de fases anteriores se preservan como evidencia histórica y nunca sustituyen a las autoridades activas del baseline exclusivo.

architectureAssessment.frontend: Svelte 5 + TypeScript strict + Vite SPA; no SvelteKit
architectureAssessment.tests: Vitest + Playwright + supplemental axe + manual WCAG
architectureAssessment.worker: Cloudflare Worker read-only SEC streaming gateway
architectureAssessment.persistence: native IndexedDB opt-in, immutable records and CAS pointers

confirmed: CIK-first identity and zero-padded ten-digit CIK
data.sec.gov submissions/XBRL APIs require no API key
Company Facts is the broad company facts endpoint
Frames is aggregate and not used for issuer fact selection

wcagAssessment.principle: Level AA requires satisfying all applicable Level A and Level AA success criteria; automated tools do not replace manual judgment.

normativeBudgets.workers: <=2,000 requests/day, p95 CPU <=4 ms, one upstream subrequest, <=0.5 MiB compressed bundle
normativeBudgets.d1: <=50,000 rows read/day, <=1,000 rows written/day, <=50 MiB, <=2 queries/invocation

cloudflareVerification.headroomAssessment: Architecturally viable on Free tiers with large normative headroom; implementation proof is blocked by ANA-008/ANA-009, not by current official quotas.

runtimeRisks: Workers Free CPU target (4 ms p95) is conservative and must be measured against large streamed SEC payloads.
Browser memory and long-task behavior for 64 MiB SEC responses and 50,000-row CSV imports remains an implementation-time risk.
IndexedDB eviction/corruption must surface deterministic local recovery and cannot silently advance pointers.
SEC schema/taxonomy drift requires exact mapping/version governance and partial results, never fuzzy inference.
Manual WCAG evidence is required for criteria not reliably automatable.
postMvpRisks: CNV, non-SEC global coverage, automated market providers, valuation and background schedulers remain deliberately deferred.
Any future Cloudflare service or paid tier requires a new Spec-Driven cycle and cannot be introduced by implementation convenience.
Future IndexedDB/D1 migrations require explicit versioned authorities and rollback evidence.

nextAction.exactAction: Use v0.20 plus these four external reports to remediate only the listed findings, rebuild the task DAG and validation closure, rerun the full read-only analysis from zero, and create a later verifiable baseline only after the rerun result is conforming.
